title: I guess this is the first AI Text to Game Platform with Goal / Tasks / Value based evaluation updates and Game Management system from NLP / LLM Perspective with 0 code?
author: GoodLopsided233
selftext:
A recent release differentiate our product RPGGO with AI Dungeon, Character AI and more general chat based text game.

* **Auto AI Game Task-Progress Check and Value-based Loose Condition Added.** Your game's tension is now under your control.
* **Player Interface Redesign with Clearer and More Upgraded UI, Directing Players to the Game Target and Ready for More Game Settings.**

Here is the description on the release and how it's implemented. Also a paper on discussing this technology is written to elaborate on how we make it happened: [https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.08195](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.08195)

  
If you are a writer or a non-code person, you can use your word and language to describe your goal, and, without writing complicate logic conditions, the game's AI management system in the backend will control the game progress and pass/fail condition for you.

  
This is an effortless way to create your own game with logic judgement details, more granular approach with four sub goals can be triggered. Here is a screenshot on how it can be used, and how player can experience in game
